items.name: pendant
items.summary: Nordic nRF9160 DK (nRF9160 SiP), non-secure app under TF-M minimal

items.name: io
items.summary: ONE user button, devicetree alias sw0. Press starts a conversation; second press ends it. It is also pokable over J-Link for testing.

items.name: storage
items.summary: microSD over SPI. CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_SDMMC, FATFS (ELM) with exFAT enabled. Mount is FS_FATFS.

items.name: audio
items.summary: I2S microphone, 15,625 Hz capture, Opus-encoded uplink at 16 kHz / 16 kbps, complexity 0

items.name: bridge
items.summary: Adafruit HUZZAH32 (ESP32 classic), 240 MHz dual core, 320 kB DRAM

items.name: network
items.summary: LTE-M (Cat-M1) via the nRF9160 modem. Half duplex in practice.

items.name: stack
items.summary: Cloudflare Worker (Express-style). D1 for jobs/history/memory, R2 for audio. Audio retention 30 days, sweep disabled, ~100 recordings stored.

items.name: power
items.summary: USB or battery. LTE-M transmit bursts draw far more than idle.
